description: This file defines a Flutter widget named PrimaryTopNav which creates a top navigation bar with 5 destinations: Home, Catalog, Search, Cart, and Account. It manages visual styles, interactivity, and notifies a parent widget of selection changes via a callback.

classes.name: PrimaryTopNav
classes.description: A StatelessWidget implementing PreferredSizeWidget that renders a top navigation bar with 5 destinations and manages selection state through external parameters.

methods.name: preferredSize
methods.description: Returns the preferred size of the widget, set to a height of 64 pixels.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the navigation bar, including tabs, styling, and interaction handling.
